name: folio
description: A calm Markdown reader for VS Code: reading themes, table of contents, focus mode, notes in the margin and offline translation of what you select.

folio.translation.enabled.description: Show a translation tooltip when you select text in the preview.

folio.translation.targetLanguage.markdownDescription: Language to translate into. Translation runs offline; the model for each language pair (about 22 MB) is downloaded once, only when you click **Download** in the tooltip or run **Folio: Manage Offline Languages**.

folio.translation.sourceLanguage.description: Language of your documents. "auto" detects it from the selected sentence (falling back to the whole document).

folio.translation.modelsPath.markdownDescription: Folder with the offline translation models, one subfolder per pair (e.g. `enit/`). Leave empty to use the extension storage. Copy the files here yourself if you never want the extension to download anything.

folio.previewTheme.description: Theme of the preview: light, dark, or sepia (a warm reading theme).

folio.codeBlockTheme.description: Syntax highlighting theme of code blocks. "auto" picks the one matching the preview theme.

enumDescriptions: Always use the selected preview theme.
Switch between Light and Dark following the editor theme (Sepia stays as is).
Switch between Light and Dark following the operating system appearance.
folio.previewColorScheme.description: Whether Light/Dark follow the editor or the operating system instead of the theme you pick.

folio.reading.fontSize.description: Text size of the preview, in pixels.

folio.reading.lineHeight.description: Space between the lines of text.

folio.reading.font.description: Font of the text: the theme's own, sans-serif, serif, or a font designed for legibility.
enumDescriptions: The preview theme's font.
A system sans-serif font.
A system serif font.
Designed for legibility, with letters that are hard to confuse (bundled).
Weighted letter shapes that some readers with dyslexia find easier (bundled).

folio.reading.justify.markdownDescription: Justify paragraphs and hyphenate long words (in the document's language), like a printed page.

folio.reading.outline.description: Show the table of contents button, with the section you are reading highlighted.

enumDescriptions: The first time the table of contents opens in a preview too narrow for it, widen the preview; after that its width is up to you.
Every time it opens in a preview too narrow for it, widen the preview, and give the room back when it closes (unless the layout changed meanwhile).
Never resize the preview: in narrow previews the table of contents floats over the text.
folio.reading.outlineFit.markdownDescription: Make room for the table of contents beside the text by widening the preview, taking room from the editor next to it (which keeps at least 260 pixels).

folio.reading.outlineAutoClose.markdownDescription: When the table of contents floats over the text (narrow previews), a click on the text closes it.

folio.reading.collapsible.markdownDescription: Fold a section by clicking the arrow next to its heading.

folio.reading.hoverPreviews.markdownDescription: Show footnotes, and the section a link points to (in this document or another Markdown file), when the pointer rests on them.

folio.reading.keyboard.markdownDescription: Keys to move through the document: `j`/`k` next/previous paragraph, `J`/`K` next/previous heading, `g`/`G` top/bottom, `t` table of contents, `Alt+←` back after following a link.

folio.reading.progress.description: Show the reading time and a reading progress bar.

folio.reading.focusMode.description: Dim everything except the paragraph (or sentence) you are reading. The key in folio.reading.focusKey, or Folio: Toggle Focus Mode, turns it on and off.

enumDescriptions: A heading with everything below it up to the next heading (paragraphs, lists, tables); cut into parts only when it does not fit in the window.
One block at a time: a paragraph, a list item, a table.
Only the sentence you are reading.
One notch of the mouse wheel, ↑/↓ or j/k moves the focus to the next or previous section (or paragraph), and the page scrolls to it.
The focus follows the paragraph at the reading line as you scroll.
folio.reading.focusNavigation.markdownDescription: How the focus moves in focus mode.

enumDescriptions: The rest of the text is lighter.
Lighter and slightly blurred.
Much lighter and blurred.
folio.reading.focusStrength.markdownDescription: How much the text outside the focus fades in focus mode.

folio.reading.focusKey.markdownDescription: A key that turns focus mode on and off while the pointer is on the preview (and the preview has the keyboard focus). Empty: no key. *Folio: Toggle Focus Mode* can also get a shortcut of its own.

folio.reading.resume.description: Reopen each document where you stopped reading, when the preview is not following an editor.

folio.notes.enabled.markdownDescription: Add notes to text selected in the preview.

enumDescriptions: In a comment at the end of the Markdown file: notes travel with it and an AI reading the file sees them. Other Markdown viewers do not show the comment.
In a file next to the document, `<file>.folio.json`.

folio.notes.author.markdownDescription: Your name on new notes and replies. Empty: your Git `user.name`, else your system user name.

folio.scrollSync.description: Synchronize scrolling between the editor and the preview.

folio.liveUpdateDebounceMs.description: Delay in milliseconds before the preview updates after an edit.

folio.breakOnSingleNewLine.description:
Render a single line break as
(GitHub does not).

folio.wikiLinks.markdownDescription: Render `[[wiki links]]` as Obsidian writes them: `[[Page]]`, `[[Page|text]]`, `[[Page#Heading]]`, and `![[image.png]]` to show an image. A page is the Markdown file of that name, next to the document or anywhere in the workspace.

enumDescriptions: Hide the front matter, as GitHub's rendered prose does not show it.
Show it as a quiet header above the document: one row per entry, lists as tags.
folio.frontMatter.markdownDescription: The YAML (or TOML) front matter at the top of a document.

folio.customCss.markdownDescription: A CSS file of your own, applied after Folio's styles in the preview and in HTML and PDF exports (for example to change fonts or colours). An absolute path, `~/…`, or a path relative to the workspace folder. It is reloaded when you save it.

folio.chromePath.description: Path of Chrome, Chromium, Edge or Brave used for PDF export. Leave empty to detect it automatically.

folio.hideBuiltInPreviewButton.description: Hide the preview buttons of VS Code's built-in Markdown preview (editor title bar, explorer and tab menus), so only this extension's button is shown.

folio.openInReader.markdownDescription: Open Markdown files in the Folio Reader, the reading view in its own tab, instead of the text editor (the **Open Source** button in its title bar opens the text). Sets VS Code's `#workbench.editorAssociations#` for `*.md` and `*.markdown`; turning it off removes them. Any Markdown file can also be opened with **Open With… › Folio Reader**.

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && node scripts/build.mjs --tests && node scripts/run-integration-tests.mjs
